description: This file defines a TurnTrackingObserver class that monitors conversation turns in a pipeline, tracking start and end events based on user and bot speech frames, handling interruptions, timeouts, and pipeline lifecycle events.

classes.name: TurnTrackingObserver
classes.description: An observer class that tracks conversation turns by monitoring specific frame events, managing turn state, handling timeouts, and emitting turn start/end events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TurnTrackingObserver with parameters for frame history size and turn end timeout, sets initial state variables, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frame events, updates turn state based on frame type, and manages turn start/end logic.

methods.name: _schedule_turn_end
methods.description: Schedules a timeout to end the current turn if no further speech activity occurs.

methods.name: _cancel_turn_end_timer
methods.description: Cancels any scheduled turn end timeout.

methods.name: _end_turn_after_timeout
methods.description: Ends the turn if the timeout expires without further bot speech.

methods.name: _handle_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles user speech frames, managing interruptions and starting new turns as needed.

methods.name: _handle_bot_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles bot speech frames, marking bot as speaking and canceling turn end timers.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles bot stop speaking frames, scheduling turn end with timeout.

methods.name: _handle_pipeline_end
methods.description: Handles pipeline end or cancel frames, ending active turns.

methods.name: _start_turn
methods.description: Starts a new conversation turn, resets relevant state, and emits a turn start event.

methods.name: _end_turn
methods.description: Ends the current turn, calculates duration, updates state, and emits a turn end event.
